## Overview


## Set-up


```{r}
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse) 
library(readxl) # To read Excel files
library(kableExtra) # For data tables
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)
library(ggtext) 
library(showtext) 

```

## About the data


```{r}
#| warning: false

poverty_madagascar <- read_excel("income-poverty-madagascar.xlsx")

```


```{r}
#| warning: false

poverty_madagascar <- poverty_madagascar |>
  mutate(Region = str_to_title(Région),
         Proportion = as.numeric(str_replace(Valeur, " %", ""))
         )
           
```

After reshaping, data looks like this:
```{r}
#| warning: false

poverty_madagascar |>
  filter(Region != "Madagascar") |>
  select(Region, Proportion) |>
  arrange(desc(Proportion)) |>
  head(15) |>
  kbl(
    caption = "Proportion of the population living below the national poverty line, 2012"
    ) |>
  kable_paper("hover", full_width = F)

```

## 

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| output: false

ggplot(
  poverty_madagascar,
  aes(
    x = Proportion,
    y = reorder(Region, Proportion)
  )
) +
  geom_bar_interactive() +
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of the population living below the national poverty line | 2012",
    x = "Proportion (%)",
    caption = "Source: Enquête Nationale de Suivi des Objectifs du Millénaire pour le Développement - ENSOMD 2012-2013 <br> Design: PhD. Juan Torres Munguía"
  ) 

```
